notes: "The third problem showed up when I asked AI to work on Google Slides or PowerPoint decks. To check its own work, the agent often has to render the whole slide to a picture and look at it. That is a useful review, but it is not something you can measure, compare or optimise: every check is a fresh guess from pixels. So I wanted a slide format where the agent reads the slide as data. On the right is a real excerpt from the 1BNA slide in this very project: the chart is an object with its bounds, its twelve values and its axis range. An agent can change one value or one label without touching anything else, and the change can be diffed. I still look at renders for composition and readability; they are a review surface, not the editable model."

designIntent.purpose: Reason 3: screenshot-only review cannot be measured; show the slide as data from this project's own page file.
keep: Code excerpt faithful to pages/AVNM.page, marked shortened
